🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) and style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +7.71% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND, EXC (1W: +6.55% | 1M: +5.36%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: DE (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +7.17%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -5.42% | 1M: +5.73%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -12.33%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +5.52%) CORRECTION. Materials and Financials also showing weakness at the sector level.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: OXY (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND; DE (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%) ABOVE TREND; VST (1W: +7.71% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +6.75% | 1M: -14.38%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), cyclical bias in the top ranks.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MPC (1W: -5.83% | 1M: +12.35%) CORRECTION; IBM (1W: -6.06% | 1M: -11.54%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -21.18%) BELOW TREND; RCL (1W: -7.01% | 1M: +14.94%) CORRECTION; BKNG (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -20.28%) BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in several big-cap tech/tech-adjacent names and services.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: OXY (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence noted: multiple megacaps (AAPL, NVDA, META) show 1W down vs 1M up—this is a MAJOR DIVERGENCE, so treat as tactical rather than a broad signal.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with a CORRECTION bias: AAPL (1W: -5.42% | 1M: +5.73%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +5.52%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -12.33%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -5.95%) BELOW TREND. Sector-level weakness persists while select names show longer-term gains—watch for consolidation or rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Generally soft: JPM (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +1.75%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -1.91%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -2.16%) BELOW TREND. Financials are not leading this week and add to the mixed market backdrop.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive tone but mixed internals: JNJ (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +13.15%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +3.95% | 1M: -14.33%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: +0.96% | 1M: -1.57%) RECOVERY. Healthcare remains a relative safe harbor amid cross-market noise.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Industrials and Utilities exposure (DE (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +7.71% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor Energy strength in OXY (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to lagging large-cap techs showing CORRECTION or BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, INTC). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: OXY (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +7.17%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -5.42% | 1M: +5.73%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -12.33%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -7.60% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +6.44%) and Industrials (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +9.80%) on strong 1W leadership. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.85% | 1M: -5.81%), Materials (1W: -2.83% | 1M: +9.34%) and Financials (1W: -1.59% | 1M: -0.59%) remain at risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +5.52%) CORRECTION for a decisive weekly close above its 1M range for renewed momentum or a break below the recent weekly low as a trend-failure trigger. Watch AAPL (1W: -5.42% | 1M: +5.73%) CORRECTION for stabilization above recent support or continuation below the 1W range. Monitor OXY (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%) ABOVE TREND for hold of the breakout area as confirmation of energy participation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GE (+65): GE (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +7.17%) ABOVE TREND — positive order/dividend headlines, price confirming sentiment. AMZN (+55): AMZN (1W: +0.38% | 1M: -11.32%) RECOVERY — bullish sales headlines but price shows short-term divergence; watch follow-through. GOOGL (+55): GOOGL (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -5.95%) BELOW TREND — positive adoption headlines are present but price has not confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
GOOGL (-70): GOOGL (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -5.95%) BELOW TREND — negative legal/news flow aligns with price weakness. BA (-60): BA (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND — operational headlines confirming softness. MPC (-50): MPC (1W: -5.83% | 1M: +12.35%) CORRECTION — insider selling headline with 1W weakness versus 1M strength is mixed and warrants monitoring.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. OXY (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND and DE (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among megacaps (AAPL, NVDA, META) and mixed news flow on GOOGL — monitor for confirmation before re-positioning.
